q: What CBAM figure does an EU buyer need for rebar from a gas DRI mill in western Algeria?
title: Algerian DRI rebar: the CBAM figure
short: Embedded direct emissions per tonne of rebar: gas used to reduce iron ore pellets, carbon and lime in the electric arc furnace, and reheating fuel. Gas based DRI runs well below blast furnace steel, so a verified actual figure usually beats the EU default.
audience: EU importers of rebar, wire rod and billets from the Oran and Bethioua steel complexes

ul: Natural gas in the DRI module.
Electrodes, charge carbon and lime in the arc furnace.
Bought pellets are not a precursor; bought DRI or billets are.

p: Reported, not charged, for steel. Algeria's grid runs on gas, so indirect emissions are moderate.
A verified figure per tonne for the product and period, and whether scrap was charged with the DRI.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
